translationRepairs: I hear that your commandery head once temporized and bowed north to Yan Ya’s teeth, then afterward came to awareness and dwelt in retirement cultivating virtue.
I hear that your commandery head once temporized and bowed north to Yan Ya, then afterward came to awareness and dwelt in retirement cultivating virtue.
In 北面延牙, 延牙 is the personal name Yan Ya (also used for Yan Cen), not 牙 as 'teeth'; the literal wrongly appends 'teeth' to the name, and the proposed removal restores the sense.
